prompt: In chess, a bishop moves only diagonally. A bishop starts the game on a light-coloured square. Which statement about it is true for the whole game?

options.text: It can reach dark squares after two moves
It can reach any square on the board
It can only ever land on light-coloured squares
It switches colour every time it moves

explanation: A diagonal move changes the row and column by the same amount, which always lands on a square of the same colour. So a bishop that starts on a light square stays on light squares forever.
